mapper.select: SELECT K.*, S.ShopName AS ShopName FROM shopwizard.tOrdOrderKeywrd K INNER JOIN shopwizard.tCmpShop S ON K.ShopCode = S.ShopCode WHERE K.KeywrdSeq = #{keywrdSeq}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO shopwizard.tOrdOrderKeywrd ( KeywrdSeq, KeywrdName, KeywrdSect, ShopCode, State, Remark, RegistId, RegistName, RegistDate, ChangeId, ChangeName, ChangeDate ) VALUES ( #{keywrdSeq}, #{keywrdName}, #{keywrdSect}, #{shopCode}, #{state}, #{remark}, #{registId}, #{registName}, NOW(), #{changeId}, #{changeName}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE shopwizard.tOrdOrderKeywrd SET KeywrdSeq = #{keywrdSeq}, KeywrdName = #{keywrdName}, KeywrdSect = #{keywrdSect}, ShopCode = #{shopCode}, State = #{state}, Remark = #{remark}, ChangeId = #{changeId}, ChangeName = #{changeName}, ChangeDate = NOW() WHERE KeywrdSeq = #{keywrdSeq}
